scripts.title: Script  AuroraHud
scripts.features:
· Infinite Stamina – It keeps its infinite energy, allowing it to run nonstop.
· Speed Booster – Increases your movement speed in the game.
· Speed Boost Config – Allows adjusting the level/intensity of the speed increase.
· Anti Ragdoll – It prevents your character from falling or losing control (ragdoll).
· Anti Stun – It prevents your character from being stunned or incapacitated.
· NoClip – It allows you to cross walls and solid objects.
· ESP Player – Shows the location of other players through walls.
· ESP Killer – It highlights the killer/enemy position on the map.
· ESP Traps – It reveals traps scattered around the scene.
· ESP Generators – Show us where the generators are on the map.
· ESP Fuse Boxes – It indicates the location of the fuse boxes.
· ESP Escapes – Show us where the escape exits are.
